About Us

Sauce Labs is the world’s largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world’s top ten largest financial institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI-driven code generation and enterprise-grade software quality. This is a hybrid /hub role working from your home in London, which means you may be expected to work from a designated co-working space from time to time, and will otherwise work remotely from home, until such time as a dedicated office is established.

  • Strategic focus getting multi-threaded in accounts to different personas, different business units and various levels up to C-Suite resulting in significant ARR growth in the account
  • Exceed annual quota and quarterly revenue targets while maintaining accurate and updated pipeline and forecasts.
  • Provide specific expertise during the sales process by collaborating internally with cross-functional teams, including Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Engineering, Product Management and Executive leadership.

In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

  • Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.
